Addresses help: host:port as reachable from the phone, at most 4. Empty: detected automatically. Required if ioBroker runs in Docker.
Length of notification texts: Notification title and text are cut after
Reload hint: After the instance restarted, for example after saving this page, reload this page before pairing apps.
Cards hint: Only cards reach the phones, never single data points. Choose a data point for each part the card should show; parts without a data point are missing on the card. Profiles release cards via their room or individually. Saving restarts the instance; connected apps are briefly disconnected.
Name: Name
Colour temperature (number with min and: Colour temperature (number with min and max, K or mired)
Label help: Empty: the name of the data point
Profiles hint: A profile determines which cards an app sees and may operate. Which profile a phone has is set in the Apps tab. Saving restarts the instance; connected apps are briefly disconnected.
Single cards to control: Single cards to view and operate
Single cards help: In addition to the rooms; a single release also applies if it allows less than the room. Cards with calls or notifications of the apps are only released individually.
Blocked help: Never visible, even if a room or a single release contains them.
